title: Freelance Hunter
status: dormant (legacy system; not in the M1/M7 database yet: docs/proposals/legacy_offices.md)
brief: Legacy system: the freelance job pipeline (private repo thedonnasystem/freelance-pipeline). Polls RemoteOK, WeWorkRemotely and Freelancer.com for AI-automation work and drafts proposals for AAA Adoption. Every proposal and bid is a draft for the owner's review: nothing is submitted without his approval.

agents.title: Job scout
agents.prompt: Score job posts for fit: a contract or freelance engagement AAA Adoption can deliver (AI automation, n8n, chatbots, agents). Reject full-time employee roles and posts that only mention AI in company boilerplate. Report counts and the reason for every rejection class.

agents.title: Proposal writer
agents.prompt: Draft a 3 to 5 sentence proposal that cites one specific detail of the post, states the delivered capability honestly and ends with one low-friction next step. Never invent results, prices or clients. Drafts go to the owner; submitting is red.

legacy.stack: Python (requests, feedparser, APScheduler, anthropic), SQLite on a Railway volume, Telegram push

dry_run.note: dry_run.py ships on the improvement PR: fetches the public boards, filters, and prints counts; no AI call, no Telegram, no bid.

legacy.tests_note: No tests on main; the improvement PR adds tests/ (stdlib unittest).

changes.change: Fix the job filter: on the live boards (Nov 23) 70 of 370 posts 'qualified', almost all full-time roles whose boilerplate mentions AI agents, so each paid AI draft went to a post nobody can bid on. The PR's title-and-contract scoring passes 3 (one real independent-contract role). The boards carry almost no freelance gigs: Freelancer.com is where volume would come from.
Redeploy the service (the Railway deployment was removed in July) once the owner sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY billing and TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
Freelancer.com bids auto-submitted with no review; the PR makes review the default (FREELANCER_AUTO_SUBMIT=0). Owner creates the Freelancer.com developer app and completes the one-time OAuth.
